title: Stream Recovery & Buffer Optimization, Fullscreen TV Surfing Arrows Removal & Live TV Scroll Ceiling
releaseNotes:
• Streaming Engine & Recovery Optimization: Tuned DefaultLoadControl buffer parameters (8s min buffer, 500ms initial playback buffer, 1000ms rebuffer) to prevent chunk starvation, added a 15-second HTTP socket read timeout to detect and reconnect dead/hung streams, tightened the live stream watchdog to 4s, and configured live target offset (4s target, 2s min, 10s max) to eliminate live-edge chasing
• Fullscreen Live TV Arrows Removal: Automatically hid on-screen channel surfing up/down buttons during fullscreen Live TV on Google TV, Firestick, and non-touch displays while retaining them on touchscreen devices
• Live TV Category Scroll Ceiling: Permanently fixed focus escaping from Live TV categories into the preview screen when holding D-pad UP, matching Movies and Series behavior; guarded asynchronous scroll updates and debounced category selection
